integrity.originality_scope: Compared with inspected recent primary sources, the claimed new content is the fixed-order optimal inverse-square laws, eventual uniqueness, and maximizing-ray displacements.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic localization of global maxima via published differential equations, coupled with standard compact Debye expansions and exact symbolic algebra.
integrity.supplementary_check: CHECK.py checks 33 symbolic and numerical identities; not a proof for infinitely many real orders.

scientific_limitations: The asymptotic formulas and eventual uniqueness are established only for sufficiently large positive real order; no explicit onset threshold or effective remainder constant.
The theorem uses existing sharp global bounds and classical Debye asymptotics; no independent proof of those established inputs is claimed.
The pointwise product coefficient along the limiting critical ray is already recoverable from Segura arXiv:2608.03633; the new result concerns global optimality and both shifted maximizers.
An unindexed treatment of identical optimized large-order asymptotics may exist.
title: Second-order optimality gaps for the two sharp modified-Bessel product bounds
